summary: Iter72 — Order History Merge (MART + SHOP) FULLY VERIFIED end-to-end. Backend: 3/3 new tests in test_orders_merge_iter72.py pass — (a) /api/shop/orders/me contract {items:[…]} with snapshot.lines/item_count/currency/total/delivery_address/module='shop'; (b) same customer with 1 MART + 1 SHOP order surfaces both when combining /orders/me + /shop/orders/me; (c) shop-only customer regression — /orders/me may be [] but SHOP list is preserved (never swallowed). Frontend Playwright on desktop 1440x900 at /profile/activities?tab=orders (DesktopProfileShell wrapping MobileActivities): 4 merged rows rendered (2 SHOP + 2 MART) sorted by created_at DESC — data-testids m-act-ord-shpord_… and m-act-ord-ord_… coexist. Filter chips: ALL default = rgb(119,188,31) #77BC1F green; SHOP active = rgb(252,196,76) #FCC44C amber; MART active = rgb(119,188,31) #77BC1F green; FOOD active = rgb(255,112,67) #FF7043 orange and filters both SHOP and MART OUT (0 rows) as expected. SHOP row summary strings verified: 'SHOPbakēd', number 'SHOP-CI-2026-00006', '1 items', '1500 CFA', 'Sep 01'; MART row 'MARTbakēd BK52B44385 · 1 items 3900 CFA'. Routing verified: SHOP row click → /shop/order/{shpord_id} (ShopOrderConfirmation page); MART row click → /orders/{ord_id}. Resilience: intercepting BOTH /orders/me and /shop/orders/me with 500 → page does NOT crash and shows the graceful 'No orders yet' empty state with Browse Stores CTA. Guest state (no token) shows the m-activities-signin GuestSignInPrompt (verified from first attempt without token in localStorage).
critical_code_review_comments: MobileActivities useEffect correctly uses Promise.all with per-endpoint .catch(() => []) — if either /orders/me or /shop/orders/me fails, the other still surfaces its orders and the page never crashes. Verified empirically by stubbing both to 500.

normaliseShopOrder maps snapshot.lines → items[] with product.name/price/quantity/line_total — this is the right cheap source for the list view (no per-order round-trip). The variant_id is used as the row's synthetic item id which is safe because it's stable within an order.
MODULE_TONE.shop = '#FCC44C' correctly drives both the active filter chip background AND the row icon+status pill tint via `${tone}22` alpha suffix. Verified computed background rgb(252,196,76).

Route dispatch `o.module === 'shop' ? /shop/order/{id} : /orders/{id}` is the right module-aware split — the SHOP order confirmation page is bound at /shop/order/:orderId in CustomerApp.jsx per the reference, and MART orders land on the existing /orders/{id} tracking page.

Minor: MobileActivities.jsx status pill for a SHOP order in 'paid' state uses the amber tone `${tone}22` — but for a MART order in 'delivered' state it forces green (#77BC1F22) regardless of module. If SHOP delivered orders start flowing, the delivered pill will paint green even for SHOP rows. Not a bug today (SHOP checkout returns 'paid'/'pending_payment' not 'delivered'), but worth guarding when SHOP fulfilment lifecycle lands.

Regression footprint is small and safe: only the merge in useEffect + MODULE_TONE.shop + row onClick routing changed. Deliveries tab still keys off same `orders` list but filters by MART/FOOD active statuses — since SHOP orders come in 'paid' status not in ['confirmed','preparing','picked_up','on_the_way'], they naturally do NOT appear in Deliveries → Active. Verified visually.

rca of the issue: N/A — implementation was correct; verified via new backend contract tests + Playwright behaviour tests. Key architectural decision was smart: FE merges via two independent GETs behind Promise.all with individual .catch fallbacks, keeping backend contracts unchanged and giving graceful degradation when either endpoint transiently 500s.
